GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-12-06T07:10:35Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: The order of `doOnSubscribe` changed in RxJava 2 without documentation
Description: We noticed one of our tests failing because or an ordering issue with `doOnSubscribe`. In RxJava 1 downstream `doOnSubcribe` would be called before upstream but it's the reverse in RxJava 2.

Here's a code snippet that showcases the problem:
```java
Observable.empty()
	.doOnSubscribe(() -> System.out.println("RX1 upstream"))
	.doOnSubscribe(() -> System.out.println("RX1 downstream"))
	.subscribe();
```
This will produce the following log statements:
```
RX1 downstream
RX1 upstream
```
while the following snippet:
```java
io.reactivex.Observable.empty()
	.doOnSubscribe(d -> System.out.println("RX2 upstream"))
	.doOnSubscribe(d -> System.out.println("RX2 downstream"))
	.subscribe();
```
produces the following statement:
```
RX2 upstream
RX2 downstream
```

Is this an intended change?
